title: pavonia semperflorens
intro: Pavonia semperflorens, commonly known as Rose Mallow, is a flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae, native to the tropical and subtropical regions of the Americas. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing pain and swelling, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pavonia semperflorens include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant, making it a valuable remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
